== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|The dragons{{!}}Dragon Descends is a powerful combat [[technique]] utilized by [[Lindon]]. The maneuver manifests as red-and-[[black madra]] claws that swirl with [[aura]], functioning as a condensed version of the Void Dragon’s Dance{{!}}Void Dragon's Dance. When executed, the [[technique]] resonates with [[Lindon]]'s Authority{{!}}authority and can be concentrated around his hand to deliver devastating strikes. It has been used effectively against high-level threats, including a [[Dreadgod]] and the [[Fiend]], causing massive [[destruction]] upon impact.}}

== Waybound ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|[[Lindon]] originally intended to utilize The dragons{{!}}Dragon Descends as a means to finish [[Northstrider]]. This specific [[technique]], which is used by [[Orthos]], possesses sufficient power to move a [[Dreadgod]] provided that [[fire aura]] is present. During the confrontation, [[Malice]] managed to catch the [[technique]] on her armored forearm. The resulting detonation ultimately filled the world with [[Void authority]].}}

<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">5</span></div>
<ul class="wv-fact-list mw-collapsible-content">
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|[[Lindon]]'s plan was to finish [[Northstrider]] with [[The Dragon Descends]].<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c11">''Waybound'', chapter 11</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|[[The Dragon Descends]] is a [[technique]] used by [[Orthos]].<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c12">''Waybound'', chapter 12</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|[[The Dragon Descends]] [[technique]] has enough power to move the [[Dreadgod]] but requires [[fire aura]].<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c19">''Waybound'', chapter 19</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|[[Malice]] caught [[The Dragon Descends]] on her armored forearm.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c28">''Waybound'', chapter 28</ref>}}</li>
